narratives.body: Pats Pulpit reports that Christian Gonzalez is good to play despite a newly announced illness. Yahoo Sports notes that Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel is set to end a 27-year streak of playing in the Thanksgiving game against the Bears.
narratives.headline: Patriots vs. Bears: Gonzalez and Vrabel updates

narratives.body: Chicago Tribune reports on the Chicago Bears' possible move from Soldier Field.
narratives.headline: Chicago Bears: potential Soldier Field move
